report.summary: Audit of daedalus/eval/mint.py (slice provided). Found a concrete correctness bug: _JUNK_KEYWORDS includes 'raise', which is not a reserved word in all supported languages (e.g., C++, Go, JavaScript), contradicting the docstring claim. This causes any symbol named 'raise' to be incorrectly excluded as junk, silently deflating recall. Additionally, _mint_from_diffs lacks per-file error handling around _diffed_symbols; a parser failure in one file could crash minting, violating the 'never raise' contract. The provided slice cuts off during _mint_from_diffs, preventing full verification of label

risks.finding: _JUNK_KEYWORDS contains 'raise', which is a valid identifier in several supported languages (C++, Go, JavaScript). The docstring claims the set includes only words reserved in EVERY supported language, but 'raise' is not a keyword in those languages. A diff that introduces a symbol named 'raise' will have it incorrectly filtered as junk, leading to an incomplete must_include set and a false recall deficit.
risks.trigger: A commit that adds or modifies a function/method/variable named 'raise' in a non-Python file (e.g., C++ void raise();) passed to _mint_from_diffs.

risks.finding: In _mint_from_diffs, the loop `for rel, (before_text, after_text) in scoped.items(): sizes = _diffed_symbols(...)` has no try/except. If extract_units inside _diffed_symbols raises (e.g., due to unparseable code or a parser bug), the exception propagates and aborts the entire minting process, contrary to the module's guarantee that minting must never raise.
risks.trigger: A file containing syntactically invalid code (or a known parser edge case) being processed by _diffed_symbols.

risks.finding: The audit slice ends mid-function. Many docstring claims (e.g., recording of filtered labels, cross-file-only enforcement, post-filter emptiness check, MUST_INCLUDE_CAP ranking) cannot be verified. The full implementation may have additional defects.

todos: Remove 'raise' from _JUNK_KEYWORDS or document the exception if intentional (contrary to docstring). Review all keywords against the full set of supported languages.
Add try/except around _diffed_symbols calls in _mint_from_diffs to handle per-file errors gracefully, logging and skipping the problematic file without aborting the whole mint.
Provide complete source of _mint_from_diffs to verify label hygiene recording, cross-file exclusion, and emptiness checks.

handoff.suggestion: 1) In mint.py, line defining _JUNK_KEYWORDS, remove 'raise'. 2) In _mint_from_diffs, wrap the per-file processing loop in try/except to catch exceptions from _diffed_symbols, log, and continue. 3) Review the full function to ensure diagnostics match docstring promises.
